basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old software developer from the Pacific Northwest, currently residing in the Tri-Cities, Washington. I have a deep passion for technology, design, and electronic music, which often reflects in my Reddit activities. I work as a freelance developer, which gives me the flexibility to explore my interests in various subreddits. I'm in a committed relationship and enjoy spending my free time hiking in the nearby national parks or digging into the latest jungle and tekno music tracks. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, after a day of coding and design work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My expertise lies in full-stack development, with a particular focus on user interface design. I am self-taught in graphic design, which aids my interest in Material Design and contributes to my appreciation for artistic CD covers like the jungle tekno series.
